context.text: Good evening, how are you feeling at the moment?

context.speaker: usr
context.text: Hey, how are you. I wish I can say I'm good but feeling down and nervous. :(

context.speaker: sys
context.text: Oh I am so sorry. Please know that I am happy to listen! What is going on with you?

context.speaker: usr
context.text: I'm about to lose my current job, because my contract is about to expire. I don't have another job offer on the line.

context.speaker: sys
context.text: Is there no possibility of having your contract renewed?

context.speaker: usr
context.text: They honored my current contract, but due to rising cost and expenses they are downsizing the company.

context.speaker: sys
context.text: It could be due to the pandemic, I suppose. Are you in touch with government agencies who could help you due to the exceptional circumstances?

context.speaker: usr
context.text: Yes I reached out, but unemployment won't help as much, won't cover most of my expenses. I just don't know how to deal and cope from this. I want to change my mindset but it's all at once and I can't deal with it.

context.speaker: sys
context.text: I think a good place to start would be your doctor - they might be able to refer you to a counsellor.

context.speaker: usr
context.text: I understand seeking professional help is a good move. But its more the feeling of uncertainty that I have trouble coping with. I know if I can overcome this, I can deal with it and move on. Any ideas?

context.speaker: sys
context.text: Would you consider taking some sort of job on a temporary basis, even though it is way out of your normal field? Bar tending or something? Just to make you feel you were earning.

context.speaker: usr
context.text: I do have side incomes, but I lost majority of my income. But I know I can find something in the future. I just need to overcome this anxiety and nervous feeling. Maybe then I can have confidence.

context.speaker: sys
context.text: Would you consider medication? It's not a panacea but it can help in the short term.

context.speaker: usr
context.text: No medications, a bit stronger than that. I can cope without that. Probably might seek a professional and talk it out.

context.speaker: sys
context.text: Whatever you do don't go self medicating! That does not help at all.

query: No medications, a bit stronger than that. I can cope without that. Probably might seek a professional and talk it out.
response: I hope I have been able to give you a little bit of piece of mind and I wish you a good deal of luck in the future
